content_sections.heading: CUO Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the CUO Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download CUO Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CUO Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Assistant and 2 for Field Investigator.

content_sections.heading: CUO Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Ph.D./ M.Phil./ NET/ Post graduate in any Social Science with a minimum of 55% marks; Skill in use of Data Science/ GIS/ SPSS/ R. Field Investigator: Graduate in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks; Proficiency (Reading/ Writing/ Speaking/ Translation/ Computer) in both English and Odia languages; Must be willing to travel for field work, including in rural/ interior areas; Preference will be given to candidates with a 04 years graduation program.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CUO Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUO recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Central University of Odisha recruitment is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in the CUO recruitment?
faq.answer: The Central University of Odisha is recruiting for two posts: Research Assistant and Field Investigator. There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for these positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for a Research Assistant?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Research Assistant position, candidates must possess a Ph.D./M.Phil./NET or a Post-graduate degree in any Social Science with a minimum of 55% marks, along with skills in Data Science/GIS/SPSS/R.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a Field Investigator at CUO?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Field Investigator post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/-. This is a contractual position offered by the Central University of Odisha.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for this recruitment drive by the Central University of Odisha. Both General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant and Field Investigator positions at the Central University of Odisha will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for CUO recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via Email. Candidates need to prepare their application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for a Research Assistant at CUO?
faq.answer: The monthly salary for a Research Assistant at the Central University of Odisha is Rs. 37,000/-. This is a contractual role with attractive remuneration.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum qualification for a Field Investigator?
faq.answer: A Graduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks is the minimum qualification for the Field Investigator post. Proficiency in English and Odia is also required.
